notes.title: PIONER – Closed Test Results
notes.content:
[p][b]Just recently, the closed test came to an end — and it turned out to be extremely valuable.
[/b]The pioneers of this test managed to confirm many of our theories and ideas, uncover a whole range of different bugs, and check the game’s overall stability.[/p][p]Our team has already analyzed most of the feedback and bug reports. You’ve provided invaluable help, and we hope for your continued support, dear comrades![/p][p]By the way, PvP was publicly showcased for the first time during these tests! Players could battle it out in a special [b]Clan Wars[/b] mode. We’re happy with the testing results and glad to have shown new online modes. It’s worth noting that both the open world and PvP location in the test were about a month behind their current state — and many fixes for a wide range of issues have already been implemented.[/p][p]New testing phases are already planned. Submit your applications on the website and stay tuned for updates![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]List of changes and ideas for the PvP mode [/b][/h3][p][b]
Current capture point method
[/b] — We’re working on making the “capture the flag” mode feel more classic: players will no longer be forced to spend excessive time capturing a flag.[/p][p][b]Point names
[/b] — We’ll assign names to points — A / B / C. This will make it easier for players to navigate the map and communicate with each other.[/p][p][b]Enemy visualization in TDM
[/b] — We’re addressing issues by adding a special type of visualization for enemies (NPCs and players) that will make them stand out more against the environment, along with adjustments to lighting components that interfere with visibility.[/p][p][b]Player movement
[/b] — We’ll work on fixing player movement desynchronization, which can cause noticeable “jitter” in the movement of enemies and allies.[/p][p][b]Hit registration
[/b] — The netcode is still being fine-tuned. At the moment, it’s not fully polished, which may cause issues where hits are not registered, or kills/deaths happen much faster than intended.[/p][p][b]Hit collision
[/b] — We’ll be improving hitbox accuracy on certain environment objects. We tried to catch as many of these as possible before the test, but some issues may still remain in certain areas of the map.[/p][p][b]Balance
[/b] — We’ve gathered all current feedback on PvP weapon balance and will be making additional adjustments in the near future.[/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: PIONER - Results of the demo testing
notes.content: [p]As we wrap up the testing of the demo version, we’d like to summarize the results.[/p][p]Despite numerous difficulties with server access and a multitude of bugs present in this demo, we want to highlight the following: we are satisfied with the results we’ve achieved and, most importantly, we are truly impressed by you — our community.[/p][p][/p][p]Thousands of dedicated individuals supported us with their feedback and bug reports. Thanks to their efforts, we were able to identify and prepare fixes for a wide range of issues in PIONER — problems we wouldn’t have been able to find on our own. We’re already making meaningful improvements in these areas, which you can read more about in the full article: [url="https://pionergame.com/news/pioner-results-of-the-demo-testing"]https://pionergame.com/news/pioner-results-of-the-demo-testing[/url][/p][p][/p][p]We’re definitely aiming to make the game world more vibrant and impressive, and your support has given us the opportunity to turn PIONER into a great adventure. And we will seize that opportunity. We will continue testing — both large-scale and limited.[/p][p][/p][p]To conclude, we’d like to share a video. In this clip, we’re showing the “Mainland” for the very first time. The Mainland is the most familiar open world in PIONER, and it’s the first to receive updated lighting and a full day-night cycle. This location is a living example of how we’re addressing visual shortcomings.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you — and see you soon in the next rounds of testing, where we will once again call upon the heroes who truly impressed us.[/p]

notes.title: PIONER - Fishing
notes.content:
The local waters are getting warmer, and the legendary gangster crucian carp has started to appear in the ponds. And you know what that means?

It’s time to dive into one of PIONER’s most unusual mini-games—Fishing, done in the spirit of a fighting game. Buy bait, pick the best fishing places, and head into battle with the toughest creatures of the local ponds!

For the more persistent players, there’s also a full storyline packed with tragedy and humor, featuring Shchukin the fisherman, who’ll trade you mind-blowing stories and recipes from his wild past — all in exchange for the rarest fish.

[previewyoutube=OF4wa7H7t08;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: PIONER - adressing feedback
notes.content:
We’ve recently invited a number of media and content creators to experience a demo version of PIONER and present it to their audiences. We are thrilled that so many people discovered PIONER for the first time and appreciated our unique setting, while longtime fans got to enjoy the gameplay.

During the demo presentation, we received a variety of opinions and gathered feedback that was extremely helpful to us.

The team has discussed and planned (or already implemented) a number of solutions, some of which you can see in the changelog below.

The demo version of PIONER contains one-tenth of the full game’s functionality and has no network content, but these fixes will help us successfully extend that experience to the full game.

[b]New settings[/b]

Camera shake strength adjustment
Game gamma, brightness and contrast adjustment

[b]Detector[/b]

Interaction with the detector has been expanded. In the trailer we used a more up-to-date build, where you can move easily while holding the detector. You will also be able to use “E signs” while using the detector simultaneously
Ability to adjust the detector sound via the built-in interface. There will be more features that were not included in the demo. ** Fast movement on the map**
The ability to teleport to previously discovered travel points. The phone that Edgar gives you in the prologue will come in handy.

[b]Artificial intelligence improvements[/b]

We have a large amount of work to do with the AI. Major fixes will include:

Fixing the cue spamming bug in battles and increasing the variability of cue playback
Improvements to AI behavior in various aspects including flanking, attacking, taking cover, accuracy, and enemy agility/avoidance ability
Fixing incorrect enemy reactions to grenades

[b]Prologue and story quest improvements[/b]

Improvements to the sound design and staging segments of story quests 1 and 4
Improvements to combat engagements. In particular, reworking the combat in the branches and in the church

[b]Scheduled graphical improvements[/b]

Hair appearance improvements
Work on lighting and overall scene contrast
Reduction of vignette effect (already implemented)
Planned improvements to dialog animations
Works with facial animations (major works)

[b]Ammunition issues[/b]

We have increased the amount of ammunition received when using an ammunition crate (implemented)
We will install ammunition crates more frequently, especially in combat-heavy areas
Tutorials will be added to better explain what ammo boxes are and what they look like
Installed additional ammo magazines in safe areas (implemented)
Increased the probability of ammo drops from enemies in the open world and quest zones (implemented)
Increased compensation for ammo lost due to multiple deaths

[b]Navigation improvements[/b]

We plan to improve navigation for key interactive items, including the workbench and character stash, to make them easy to find when first exploring the location
Additionally, the location of guides should also be labeled and highlighted

[b]Improvements on the interfaces we plan to make:[/b]

Workbench menu uses outdated item card with irrelevant parameters
Ability to hide interface elements in the settings or optionally

[b]Improvements to localization and voiceovers.[/b]

notes.title: This is PIONER’s inventory
notes.content:
The inventory has been significantly improved following testers' requests. Here are the examples of the improvements:

- Improved positioning and animation of the character in the frame
- Improved readability of items and inventory slots
- Redesigned the icons for the entire inventory and trading system
- Specific resources and item types (like ammunition and medicines) are now highlighted with special patterns for easier retrieval
- Now the inventory has a special highlight for armor sets. Wearing 2 or more items from a set will give a certain bonus. Such sets have highlighted frames colored by the rarity of the set items.
- Added sorting by quest items, which was very much requested
- Improved user button navigation - it is now easier to manage and sort items, making it much simpler for gamepad players
- Item cards have become more informative and gained more details, and the most important weapons and armor data is now placed in a more convenient way

notes.title: PIONER - Q&A WITH DEVELOPERS
notes.content:
[h2]We've collected the questions about the game we get asked most often and answered them👇[/h2]

[b]Can I play solo? [/b]
Yes, it will be possible to complete the story campaign without going to PvP zones and complete isolated missions without other players.

[b]What will the in-game communication be like? [/b]
The game will feature voice and text chat. Global, divided by region, party or clan.

[b]Will there be in-game purchases? [/b]
Only cosmetic in-game purchases are planned, the items are designed in the style of the game. We believe that this is the most balanced approach.

[b]On what platforms will the game be released? [/b]
The game is planned to be released for PC first and a version for next-gen consoles will be released later.

[b]Will there be armor and outfits in the game? [/b]
The game will feature unique types of armor and outfits with significant visual differences, and various characteristics and features.

[b]Can the story be completed solo/co-op? [/b]
Some quests can be completed in co-op, but not the entire storyline. 

[b]Will there be custom servers? [/b]
There is no need for this, as you can make a guild which allows you to create a similar enclave on existing servers, thanks to the server mirroring system. 

[b]Will it be cross-platform? [/b]
Yes, but without cross-play for the sake of balance between players. That means console players will not be able to play against PC players.

[b]How will the content be updated? [/b]
We plan to release regular updates, including both balancing patches and new content. Besides, players will get major additions that will open up new horizons and significantly expand the game world.

[b]Will the game be available on Linux? [/b]
Yes, the game will be available on Windows and Linux. 

[b]Will there be an anti-cheat? [/b]
Yes, we are working on its integration and will share details later. Protection against cheaters is a very important, high-priority aspect for us.

[b]What engine is the game based on?[/b] 
The game runs on Unreal Engine 4, we do not plan to switch to UE5 before the release of the game, as UE5 is very demanding on the hardware. We want as many players as possible to enjoy a quality product.

[b]Will the game have a sequel after the story is over? [/b]
We are actively working to keep the community interested in the game world. In the future, there will be endgame content and story development.

[b]Will there be an affiliate program? [/b]
Yes, it is planned, and we will share more details later. We value content creators and will definitely reward community members for it.

[b]Will the bestiary and arsenal on the site be expanded?[/b] 
Yes, we will publish new characters and weapons and continue to expand the base on the site. We want players to be able to familiarize themselves with the world of the game and get to know its components in more detail while immersing in the island of Tartarus.

[b]Is the game going to be buy-to-play? [/b] 
Yes, the game will be purchase to play. 

[b]What are the system requirements? [/b]
You can find the system requirements on the Steam page. The game will run smoothly without the most advanced specifications and you will be able to comfortably explore the world of PIONER.

[b]When is the game coming out?[/b] 
The game is set for release in 2025, we will reveal a more exact date a little later.

[b]How many people work on PIONER?[/b] 
At the moment, we have over 100 professionals from all over the world working on PIONER. 

[b]Is it necessary to participate in PvP to complete the main story?[/b] 
No, players don't necessarily need to participate in PvP. Story-based activities and activities in which you can get beaten up by other players are separated by both distance and organization.

[b]How does world division work? [/b]
The left side of the island is dominated by PvE content. The right side of the island is a PvP area. At the same time, there is only one region in the game where PvP is implemented everywhere - Shadowlands. Only partial areas with PvP rules are implemented in Middle Earth. We are also introducing additional rules to avoid bullying of solo players and to avoid campering.

[b]How does equipment progression work? [/b]
Getting the best equipment is possible in PvE and PvP activities. The main item you need to have is blueprints and resources. The latter can be obtained in a large number of activities, including PvE. 

[b]How will the artefacts work?[/b] 
In the world of PIONER, artefacts play a vital role in the economy and the equipment crafting process. Artefacts are expensive and difficult to obtain. The search for artefacts is almost always connected with anomalies, and you can only get an artefact if you have the appropriate equipment.
